name: A — Refined search panel
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied Pets4Luv homepage screenshot to create ONE polished alternative. The rescue selected this exact editorial design. Preserve the existing logo, white navigation masthead, burgundy and warm ivory palette, serif typography, golden-dog-and-cat hero photograph, exact hero headline 'Every animal deserves a next chapter.', subtitle, hero CTA, weekly featured-animal editorial content and photos, lower burgundy conversation section, and footer. Change ONLY the animal search section directly underneath the hero: replace the narrow 'FIND A FRIEND' row with Cats/Dogs/Age/Size dropdowns. Preserve all other content and styling; move lower sections down if necessary to accommodate the improved search design. Flat front-on high-resolution full desktop homepage screenshot, approximately 1536px wide, tall enough to show the entire page without cropping. This is a refinement, not a new brand or homepage. Search UI must be polished and coherent, not duplicate Cats and Dogs dropdowns. Match the established burgundy accents with restrained modern sans-serif labels inside controls. All labels readable, generous spacing, no invented result counts or claims.
ALTERNATIVE A: replace old row with an elegant wide white search panel sitting within a warm ivory section, 40px horizontal margins, 28px internal padding, modest 12px rounding, subtle shadow and fine warm-gray outline. One slim top row: editorial heading 'Find your next chapter' left and small 'View all animals →' link right. Below it a single organized horizontal controls row: a connected segmented species selector 'All pets | Cats | Dogs' with All pets selected in burgundy, an integrated field labeled 'Age' with value 'Any age' and down chevron, another field 'Size' / 'Any size', and a strong burgundy rectangular button 'Find a friend →'. Fields separated by soft vertical rules rather than a series of harsh outlined boxes. Small cat/dog line icons optional within species tabs. NO photo cards within the search panel. Panel should feel calm, refined and purposefully designed, about 190–230 desktop pixels high. Keep clear visual separation from weekly spotlight below. Every other part of the supplied screenshot remains as close as possible to the original.

name: B — Visual cat-and-dog chooser

Preserve the existing logo, white navigation masthead, burgundy and warm ivory palette, serif typography, golden-dog-and-cat hero photograph, exact hero headline 'Every animal deserves a next chapter.', subtitle, hero CTA, weekly featured-animal editorial content and photos, lower burgundy conversation section, and footer. Flat front-on high-resolution full desktop homepage screenshot, approximately 1536px wide, tall enough to show the entire page without cropping. This is a refinement, not a new brand or homepage. Species tiles are the entry to a filtered animal gallery; the all-animals link supports undecided visitors. About 260–300 desktop pixels total height. This should feel like an invitation to meet animals, not a utility form, but remain compact enough for the weekly spotlight below. Preserve all other reference page elements.
